veranderings.blok: Hoe jy 'n dier in die regte groep plaas
veranderings.voor: Moenie sy pote tel nie en moenie kyk
veranderings.na: Moenie sy pote tel nie, en moenie kyk
veranderings.rede: Two complete imperative clauses, each with its own verb and negation, are joined by 'en'; a comma separates them and makes the double 'moenie ... nie' easier to read (borderline under the AWS rule, as imperatives have no stated subject).
Used adverbially, the word group 'end aan end' is written as separate words without hyphens, like 'kop aan kop'.
